question: Which countries are members of BIMSTEC?

options.text: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand
Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Thailand
Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand
Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **BIMSTEC** stands for Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation.
 
• Member countries include **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Thailand**.
 
• BIMSTEC was established on **6 June 1997** through the Bangkok Declaration.
 
• The organization aims to foster regional cooperation among its members in various sectors such as trade, technology, energy, and tourism.
 
• BIMSTEC bridges South Asia and Southeast Asia, with a focus on the Bay of Bengal region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Focus:** BIMSTEC focuses on the Bay of Bengal region, which is strategically important for trade and maritime connectivity.
 
• **Main Objectives:** Its objectives include economic development, poverty alleviation, and strengthening regional ties.
 
• **Priority Sectors:** The organization works on 14 priority sectors including transport, communication, energy, environment, trade, investment, and counter-terrorism.
 
• **Exclusion of Pakistan:** BIMSTEC excludes Pakistan, differentiating it from other regional groups like SAARC.
 
• **Summits:** BIMSTEC holds regular summits to discuss and strategize initiatives for regional cooperation; the last summit was held in **March 2022** in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
